build_cpp_ast: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource to parse and generate abstract syntax tree nodes
generate_ast_nodes: generate AST nodes from a C++ token stream by calling AstBuilder.Generate() to yield parsed declarations and definitions
parse_cpp_file: parse a C++ file and print all AST nodes by using BuilderFromSource with the file contents and iterating over Generate()
print_cpp_identifiers: print all identifiers from C++ source files using PrintIndentifiers with a predicate function to filter which nodes to output
convert_tokens_to_type: convert C++ tokens into Type AST nodes using TypeConverter.ToType() to parse base class and template type information
